Sports Betting at Bunnico

Our Sports section covers international tournaments and domestic championships. The football selection includes the UEFA Champions League and domestic league fixtures, while dedicated categories cover basketball, tennis, ice hockey, American football and cricket. Our esports selection includes Counter-Strike, Dota 2 and eSoccer.

Our Hot Combos, Top Events and Top Outrights selections complement the main sportsbook and make it easier to find relevant events.

The Bunnico Casino app experience gives you access to thousands of slots, live dealer tables, sports betting and the Premium Shop directly from your smartphone. We've optimised our main gaming features, account management tools and cashier for mobile browsers, retaining the functionality of our desktop website.

You don't need to download a separate Bunnico app to play on Android, iPhone or iPad. Simply open our website in your mobile browser or add a shortcut to your device's home screen. Your balance, active bonuses, accumulated Chips and VIP progress remain accessible through the same account.

Why Play at Bunnico Casino on Mobile

We've optimised our game catalogue for touchscreen controls and different screen sizes. You can switch between slots, Live Casino, sports events and promotions without installing additional software. Depending on the game and your device, you can also switch between portrait and landscape orientations for a more comfortable viewing experience, particularly when accessing live tables and sports markets.

The Bunnico app experience retains the main features of your personal account. You can check your betting history, manage active bonuses, view tournament results and track your loyalty programme progress. Simply use your existing account credentials to access these features.

Mobile deposits can be made using Apple Pay and Google Pay, subject to device compatibility and cashier availability. On compatible devices, Apple Pay supports payment authentication through Face ID or Touch ID, while Google Pay may use fingerprint recognition or other supported device authentication methods. Bank cards and cryptocurrency wallets are also available, with full transaction details provided in our deposits and withdrawals section.

How to Install the Bunnico Casino App on Android

You don't need to download an APK file or search Google Play to access our casino on Android. Our mobile website works directly through your browser, and adding a home screen shortcut allows you to open it without manually entering the website address.

Follow these steps to add Bunnico to your Android home screen:

  1. Open Google Chrome on your smartphone or tablet.
  2. Visit our homepage.
  3. Open the browser menu by tapping the three-dot icon.
  4. Select Add to Home Screen or the equivalent option available in your browser.
  5. Confirm the addition of the shortcut.

The Bunnico app shortcut will then appear on your device's home screen. It provides direct access to our mobile website without requiring separate gaming files or installation packages. Menu options may vary depending on your Android and Chrome versions.

How to Install the Bunnico App on iPhone and iPad

Our mobile website works through Safari on Apple devices, with no separate download from the App Store required. You can access Bunnico Casino through a regular browser tab or create a dedicated shortcut on your iPhone or iPad home screen.

To add the shortcut to your Apple device, follow these steps:

  1. Open Safari on your iPhone or iPad.
  2. Visit the Bunnico Casino website.
  3. Tap the Share button in your browser.
  4. Select Add to Home Screen.
  5. Confirm the shortcut name and tap Add.

The shortcut provides direct access to our mobile website without having to search for it in your browser. To access your personal features, simply log in to your existing account. There's no need to register again or transfer your balance between devices.

Full Desktop Features in Your Pocket

The Bunnico Casino app experience goes beyond playing slots. We've retained access to our main gaming categories, sportsbook, financial transactions and personalised rewards system. You can switch between your smartphone, tablet and computer while using the same account.

As the Bunnico Casino app experience operates through your browser, updates to our game catalogue and website features do not require manual downloads of new installation files. The same personal data protection and identity verification procedures apply across mobile and desktop devices. We carry out KYC checks, monitor financial transactions and investigate suspicious activity. Where necessary, our team may request additional verification to confirm ownership of your account.

We support responsible gambling regardless of how you access Bunnico. Keep track of your spending and the time you devote to mobile gaming sessions, and stay within your personal gambling budget. If you need a break, our customer support team can help you activate voluntary self-exclusion.

Welcome offers are available exclusively to new players. Only one bonus can be active at any given time, and your deposit must meet the requirements of the relevant bonus stage. Claiming a bonus is entirely optional.

Daily and Weekly Challenges

Our Bunnico bonus selection combines regular rewards with interactive features that follow their own schedules and participation requirements. WinStreak runs as a seven-day challenge, while Wheel of Gods operates on a daily cycle of bonus wheel spins.

WinStreak

WinStreak features 25 levels with total rewards of up to £1,500. Progress is measured using Clovers, which are awarded for individual spins that meet the specified minimum winning amount. Each qualifying spin earns one Clover, regardless of how much the win exceeds the required threshold.

Your account displays your current level, accumulated Clovers, available rewards and the time remaining until the challenge ends. All levels must be completed within the seven-day period. The applicable minimum stake and qualifying win amount are specified in the active WinStreak terms.

Wheel of Gods

Wheel of Gods features two bonus wheels dedicated to Zeus and Hades. Each wheel contains eight segments offering different rewards. At least one successful deposit is required to access this feature.

The Zeus Wheel provides one free spin during each 24-hour cycle. Unused spins do not accumulate or carry over to the next period. The Hades Wheel becomes available after using the free spin and requires a separate payment to participate.

Potential rewards include cash bonuses ranging from £1 to £435 and between 5 and 100 Free Spins. Rewards are subject to their individual wagering requirements, with the maximum conversion of bonus funds limited to five times the relevant reward amount.

Active Tournaments

Bunnico Casino tournaments include network competitions and individual races with dedicated prize pools. Each event has its own participation rules, eligible games, minimum qualifying stakes and winner selection criteria. Current competitions can be found in our Tournaments section.

Big Sunday Blast

Eligible titles include 3 Super Coin Volcanoes and 3 African Drums, alongside other games featuring accumulative bonus mechanics. Only results from eligible games that meet the active tournament requirements count towards the competition.

Multi Race

Premium Shop and Real Rewards

Chips are the internal currency behind our Premium Shop. At Bunnico, Chips are awarded at a rate of x50 for deposits and x100 for qualifying slot wagers, subject to the shop's terms. Additional Chips may also be included in welcome packages and selected promotional offers.

Our Premium Shop includes several reward categories:

  • Free Spins - packages of free spins on selected slots.
  • Silver Case, Gold Case and Premium Case - reward cases with their own contents and conditions.
  • Bonus Money - additional bonus funds subject to individual promotional terms.
  • Real Money - cash rewards available under the shop's rules.
  • Gift Cards - vouchers for Amazon, Netflix, IKEA, Steam and other services.
  • Premium Items - physical rewards, including the 2025 Mercedes-Maybach SL 680, priced at 72,000,000,000 Chips.

Each shop item has its own price and redemption conditions. Available rewards and your Chips balance are displayed in your personal account. You can also access the main shop features through our mobile casino.

VIP Club and Personalised Rewards

The Bunnico Casino loyalty programme features 17 levels, ranging from Bronze I to Obsidian. Progression depends on Lifetime Deposits, Gems earned through deposits and Stars accumulated through gaming activity. Each level has its own qualifying requirements and available benefits.

The entry-level Bronze status includes daily cashback starting at 3%, while the highest Obsidian level offers up to 40%. Members may also qualify for daily Live Casino rakeback of up to 60%. Level-up rewards can include cash bonuses and up to 200 Free Spins.

At eligible VIP levels, we provide a personal account manager, priority support through messaging services, increased withdrawal limits and priority processing of withdrawal requests. Additional benefits include personalised cash gifts, exclusive promotional codes and private tournaments.

Participation in our VIP Club requires account verification. Your achieved status is retained during periods of inactivity, so taking a break from gambling does not result in losing your current level. Qualifying requirements and personalised rewards are displayed in the relevant section of your account.

Bonus Terms and Wagering Rules

Every Bunnico Casino bonus comes with individual terms governing activation periods, wagering requirements, maximum stakes and withdrawal limits. Bonus funds are recorded separately from your real-money balance. Relevant wagering requirements must be completed before associated winnings become eligible for withdrawal.

For example, a £100 bonus with a 40x wagering requirement requires £4,000 in bets that contribute fully towards wagering. Individual game contributions may vary according to the terms of the relevant promotion.

Our homepage features the Bonus Wager category, which brings together games eligible for bonus wagering. Not all slots, table games and Live Casino titles contribute equally towards wagering requirements. The applicable contribution rates and restrictions depend on your active Bunnico bonus.

Requesting a withdrawal before completing the wagering requirements results in the forfeiture of the active bonus and its associated winnings. Once the relevant conditions have been met, our standard withdrawal rules apply, including mandatory identity verification.

At Bunnico Casino, participation in promotional offers is entirely voluntary. You can play using your real-money balance without activating bonuses, take breaks and opt out of individual promotions. Bonuses do not guarantee winnings and should never be a reason to exceed your personal gambling budget.

pages.title: Login
pages.content:
Log in to your Bunnico Casino account to access your current balance, active bonuses, betting history and personal rewards. Your profile also keeps track of your VIP Club progress, accumulated Chips and tournament results.

The Bunnico login process requires the email address and password you provided during registration. You can sign in from a computer, smartphone or tablet using the same account details. If you've forgotten your password or encountered account access restrictions, we're here to help you regain access.

How to Log In to Bunnico Casino

To access your account, open the Log In form on our homepage. Signing in does not require you to register again or install any additional software.

Complete these two steps to access your account:

  1. Enter the email address and password associated with your account.
  2. Click Log In to confirm your details and access your profile.

Once you've completed the Bunnico Casino login process, you can manage your personal settings, view financial transactions and check the status of active promotions. To sign in from your smartphone, use our mobile casino. There's no need to create a separate mobile account.

New to Bunnico Create Your Account

If you haven't created an account yet, open the registration form and complete the required fields. Use accurate personal information, as these details will be needed for identity verification and account recovery.

Registration at Bunnico Casino involves three main steps:

  1. Enter a valid email address, create a password and complete the required registration fields.
  2. Choose an available account currency, read our terms and conditions and confirm your registration.
  3. Once your account has been created, you can select one of our three welcome packages and activate it subject to the applicable promotional terms.

New players can choose between the standard Casino Welcome Pack, VIP Welcome Pack and a separate cryptocurrency offer. Explore our Bunnico welcome bonuses and their individual terms before activating an offer. Making a deposit or claiming a bonus is not a requirement for creating an account.

How to Recover Your Forgotten Password

If you've forgotten your Bunnico Casino login password, select Forgot Password on the sign-in form. Enter the email address you used during registration and submit a password reset request. Instructions for creating a new password will be sent to your registered email address.

If the message hasn't arrived, check that you've entered the correct email address and look in your junk or spam folder. Once you've created a new password, return to the Bunnico login form and sign in using your updated credentials.

If you no longer have access to your registered email address, contact our customer support team. We may request additional information to verify your identity and confirm ownership of the account before restoring access.

Account Verification and Security

At Bunnico Casino, we use Know Your Customer (KYC) procedures to confirm your identity, age and the accuracy of your registration details. Verification helps prevent unauthorised account access, fraudulent financial transactions and the use of payment methods belonging to other individuals.

Verification may be required when your deposits reach a specified threshold, when you request a withdrawal or when suspicious activity is detected. To complete the process, we may request the following documents:

Document Purpose
Passport or Identity Document Confirmation of the account holder's identity and age
Selfie with an Identity Document Additional identity confirmation
Proof of Address Verification of your registered residential address
Proof of Payment Method Ownership Confirmation that the payment details belong to you

Your documents must be valid, clearly legible and consistent with the personal information registered on your Bunnico account. Submit them according to the instructions provided in your verification request. Processing times depend on the completeness of your documents and whether additional checks are required. We may request further information or repeat verification where necessary.

We maintain the confidentiality of your personal information and restrict access to data collected during identity verification. Verification is also a mandatory part of our withdrawal process, helping us confirm that financial transactions are authorised by the legitimate account holder.

Bunnico Login Assistance and 24/7 Support

If you encounter a Bunnico login error, check your email address, password and keyboard settings. Make sure there are no accidental spaces in your login credentials. If you're still unable to sign in, use the password recovery feature.

Our customer support team is available 24/7 via Live Chat. We can assist with Bunnico Casino login issues, account restrictions, changes to personal information and identity verification. When contacting us, you may need to provide the email address associated with your account.

We take account security and responsible gambling seriously. Keep your login credentials confidential and never share your password with anyone else. If you need a break from gambling, our team can help you activate voluntary self-exclusion.

pages.content:
At Bunnico Casino, you can fund your account and withdraw your winnings using bank cards, electronic payment services and cryptocurrencies. All financial transactions are managed through your personal cashier, where you can view available payment methods, supported currencies and applicable transaction limits.

We process withdrawal requests within three working days, while eligible VIP Club members benefit from increased withdrawal limits and priority processing. Your Bunnico account allows you to monitor your balance, deposit history and the status of financial transactions in one place.

Available Payment Methods

Our cashier supports traditional payment methods and digital assets. To fund your <a href="/">Bunnico Casino</a> account, you can use Visa and Mastercard, the Skrill e-wallet or mobile payment services such as Apple Pay and Google Pay. Cryptocurrency transactions are completed through supported digital wallets.

Minimum and maximum transaction amounts depend on your chosen payment method. Payment availability is determined by your country of residence, account currency and the conditions of the relevant payment provider.

The stated Bunnico Casino withdrawal time refers to our internal processing period and excludes any additional time required by banks, payment services or blockchain networks. Payment providers may apply their own transaction fees, and currency conversion charges may apply when payments involve different currencies.

How to Make a Deposit

To fund your balance, log in to your Bunnico account and open the cashier. The Deposit section displays available payment methods and their applicable transaction limits. Only use payment methods registered in your own name.

  1. Open the cashier and select Deposit.

  2. Choose your preferred payment method and enter an amount within the applicable limits.

  3. Check your payment details and confirm the transaction.

  4. Once your funds have been credited, you can activate an eligible bonus if you wish.

Following successful payment confirmation, funds are credited to your real-money balance. Deposit processing times depend on your chosen payment method, while cryptocurrency transactions also require confirmation from the relevant blockchain network.

New Bunnico players can choose from three welcome packages with different deposit requirements. The minimum qualifying deposit for the cryptocurrency package is 28 USDT. Before activating an offer, read our deposit bonus terms, as promotional funds are subject to separate wagering requirements and withdrawal conditions.

Deposits may also earn Chips, which can be redeemed in our Premium Shop. Your accumulated Chips are recorded separately from your real-money and bonus balances.

How to Withdraw Your Winnings

Bunnico Casino withdrawal requests are submitted through the Withdraw section of your personal cashier. You must have sufficient withdrawable funds in your real-money balance and satisfy the applicable financial and verification requirements. If you have an active bonus, its conditions may affect the amount available for withdrawal.

The Bunnico withdrawal process consists of the following steps:

  1. Open the cashier and select Withdraw.

  2. Choose an available payment method, preferably the one used for your previous deposit if it supports withdrawals.

  3. Enter the withdrawal amount and check your payment details.

  4. Provide the necessary verification documents if you have not completed KYC or further verification is required.

  5. Confirm your withdrawal request and monitor its status through your account.

Not every deposit method necessarily supports withdrawals. If your previously used payment method is unavailable for payouts, contact our customer support team to clarify the available alternatives. Transfers to bank accounts, cards or electronic wallets belonging to another person are prohibited.

Submitting a Bunnico withdrawal request while a bonus is active may result in the forfeiture of bonus funds and associated winnings. Before confirming a transaction, check your bonus balance and whether the relevant promotional requirements have been completed.

You can also make deposits and request Bunnico Casino withdrawals through our mobile casino. Financial transactions on smartphones and tablets use the same account and balance as the desktop version.

Payout Speed, Withdrawal Limits and KYC Policy

We process standard withdrawal requests within three working days. Once internal processing is complete, the transaction is passed to the relevant payment provider. The actual arrival time depends on your chosen withdrawal method and the completion of any necessary verification checks.

Bunnico withdrawal limits include minimum and maximum transaction amounts, alongside daily, weekly and monthly restrictions. Specific limits depend on your payment method and account status. Applicable amounts are displayed in the cashier and the relevant financial terms.

VIP Club Financial Benefits

Eligible members of the Bunnico Casino loyalty programme benefit from increased withdrawal limits and priority processing. Our programme consists of 17 levels, ranging from Bronze I to Obsidian, with financial privileges determined by your current VIP status.

Priority processing times are estimates rather than guaranteed payout times. Increased withdrawal limits apply to real-money balances once all relevant financial, wagering and verification requirements have been satisfied.

Identity Verification and Financial Security

At Bunnico Casino, we apply Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) procedures to verify player identities and prevent unauthorised financial transactions. Full identity verification is mandatory when requesting a withdrawal, regardless of the amount. Verification is also required when cumulative deposits exceed the specified threshold or suspicious transactions are detected.

To confirm your identity, you must provide a passport or another government-issued photographic identity document, a selfie holding the document and proof of your residential address. Where necessary, we may request bank statements, proof of payment method ownership or additional supporting information. Documents with an expiry date must remain valid for at least three months.

The personal information shown on your documents must match the details registered on your Bunnico account. Even after successful KYC verification, we may request further identity checks or additional information relating to financial transactions.

Deposit Wagering Requirements Before Withdrawal

Deposits are subject to turnover requirements before funds become eligible for withdrawal. Under our general terms, deposited funds must be wagered before a withdrawal can be processed, even when no promotional bonus has been activated. If several deposits have been made without any gaming activity, the requirement applies to the combined deposited amount.

Deposit turnover requirements are separate from bonus wagering conditions. Where a promotional offer has been activated, its individual wagering requirements must also be satisfied before the associated bonus winnings become eligible for withdrawal.

If a deposit has been duplicated or processed incorrectly due to a technical issue, you can submit a refund request. Under our Refund Policy, requests must be submitted within five working days of the deposit transaction. Approved refunds are processed within ten working days of approval.

Deposit refunds are separate from standard Bunnico Casino withdrawal requests. Funds that have already been used to place bets or participate in games are not eligible for reimbursement under the refund procedure.

We support responsible gambling and encourage you to remain in control of your spending. Only deposit within your available budget and never treat gambling as a source of income. Our customer support team is available around the clock, including for requests relating to gambling restrictions and voluntary self-exclusion.
